# portrait

> the owner funds kettle makers, rents a unit by the harbour, and rests by throwing pots.

## now

the owner runs a small fund for kettle makers that closes in 2025-06, and reports on it to one close friend. [[r:W1]] [[c:k]]

## how the owner works

in numbered steps, each reported as it is done; the gazebo permit ran to twelve. [[r:MW1]] [[r:MW11]]

## the people around the owner

a landlord they have written to nearly every day for two years, a neighbour they built a gazebo with, and a friend who tells the owner to invest slowly. [[c:chat_whatsapp_Ravi_Anand]] [[c:chat_whatsapp_Maya_Okafor]] [[r:W6]]

my read: the owner keeps work and rest apart, and writes about rest more warmly. [[r:N1]]

## the wiki

### years
- [[p:years/2024|the year 2024]]: the harbour lease renewed, and the first money into kettles.
